description: This Kotlin source file defines the `DetailsViewModel` class, which manages the state and logic for the recipe details screen in an Android application. It interacts with local data storage to handle favorite recipes and fetches recipe data from a repository.

classes.name: DetailsViewModel
classes.description: Android ViewModel for the recipe details screen, handling recipe data and favorite status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads recipe data by ID asynchronously and updates the LiveData, also checks if the recipe is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the current recipe, updating local storage and LiveData.
